title: gate add does not class a choice of which commit pins a source url as an operator-only push gate because an option names github.com
goal: A gate whose options choose the commit or url form of a kb source row is classed by its question, not made a blocking push gate by the word github in an option, so a content worker's provisional choice stays provisional (see BG-e3o47d6s for the GitLab-as-product case)
notes: SP-xt4t63xw retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Evidence: ST-q2jzknjn's worker added provisional g1 (public projection hash on github.com or private hash on gitlab.com for S-vt5s6nsz) and gate add printed 'class push (matched github): made blocking'; BG-tl74zfyr g2, a choice of where an article states a reason, was made blocking the same way.
